title: The Fall of the Four Factions
summary: A flashback shows Hongdie's master Chong Ying divining her death calamity and spending the rest of his life on a hexagram that sends his first disciple Qing He to die protecting her in the war. Back on the battlefield, Ou Zhi, the Vermilion Bird Country's early Soul Transformation guardian, strips the Country-Protecting Sky Dragon of its bloodline, and the Four Faction Alliance collapses. Wang Lin survives because the Heaven Defying Bead has absorbed the earth spirit, and the fleeing Zhou Wutai hands him the Rain Cauldron with healing pills. The Snow Region elder Lian Ning chases him down, and Wang Lin kills the elder with a heavenly tribulation called through his restriction flag, then turns down Ou Zhi's request that he summon another. Five years later the bead's earth element is complete, its time reversal has ended since Wang Lin grasped his Life and Death intent, and he travels through the new Snow Region country, finding death intent where mortals should be living.
events: Flashback: Chong Ying divines Hongdie's calamity and sends Qing He to shield her
Ou Zhi strips the Country-Protecting Sky Dragon's bloodline; the Alliance falls
Wang Lin survives thanks to the earth spirit in the Heaven Defying Bead
Zhou Wutai gives Wang Lin the Rain Cauldron
Lian Ning hunts Wang Lin; he kills Lian Ning with a heavenly tribulation
Ou Zhi asks him to call another tribulation; he declines
Five years later the bead's earth element is complete and the time difference inside it ends
cultivation: Chong Ying and Qing He: late Soul Formation. Ou Zhi: early Soul Transformation. Lian Ning: early Soul Formation. Wang Lin needs four more years to reach Soul Formation.
